notes.title: Patch Notes for Polimines 1.1.2
notes.content:
Patch Notes for Polimines 1.1.2

[list]
[*] QOL: Added option to invert controls.
[*] FIX: Fixed some options not saving properly.
[/list]

This is most likely the last update Polimines will receive. This game will always be very special to me since it was the first one I published. That said, my coding skills back then had a lot of room to grow, to put it mildly, and it's almost impossible to patch anything into this game without rewriting it entirely.

Thank you for playing!

tags.feature: QOL: Added option to invert controls.

tags.bug: FIX: Fixed some options not saving properly.

notes.title: Patch Notes for Polimines 1.1
notes.content:
Patch Notes for Polimines 1.1:

[list]
[*] NEW: 5 brand new levels!
[*] QOL: Mid-level saving.
[*] QOL: Fully customizable colours for background and tiles. (Not pixel perfect - recommended only for accessibility issues)
[*] QOL: Toggle for animated background.
[*] FIX: Fixed a bug where finishing a level would sometimes not unlock the next one. (Thanks to "Rushin Russian" for the report!)
[/list]
